# Viraj Mahesh

> Personal site of Viraj Mahesh, Group Product Manager at YouTube and UC Berkeley graduate.

The site is a single contact card. A markdown version of the homepage is available at /index.md, or by requesting https://virajmahesh.com/ with the header `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://virajmahesh.com/index.md): Name, role, and contact details
- [Resume](https://virajmahesh.com/assets/resume.pdf): Full resume (PDF)
